# 因明入正理門論述記

**ID:** X0847
**Volume:** X53
**Category:** 論集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／因明論疏
**Byline:** 唐 神泰述
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 618–907
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0847

## Contributors
- 神泰 (A000987)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The Xuzangjing transmission of Shéntài 神泰's sub-commentary on Dignāga's *Yīnmíng zhèng lǐ mén lùn běn* [KR6o0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0001). The same work is transmitted in the Taishō as *Lǐmén lùn shù jì* [KR6o0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0007) (T44n1839); the two versions are textually closely related but not identical. The Xuzangjing edition's title prefixes 因明入 ("entering into Buddhist logic") and the Taishō version omits this; the source text within both editions begins identically with "初言因明者..." and proceeds in parallel for the bulk of their lengths, with the Xuzangjing version preserving slightly more of the original commentary at points where the Taishō transmission breaks off. The catalog meta treats the two as separate entries to reflect the separate canonical placement; the present entry should be read together with [KR6o0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0007).

**Abstract**

The opening colophon "理門論述記，泰法師撰" identifies the author as "Tài Fǎshī" — i.e. Shéntài 神泰, the early Cí'ēn 慈恩 commentator and translation-bureau associate of [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98). The Xuzangjing 卍續藏 edition transmits this text from a separate manuscript line than the Taishō recension; the textual differences between the two are small but the Xuzangjing version contains some passages absent from the Taishō and the Taishō contains some absent from the Xuzangjing. Both versions are incomplete relative to the lost full text that is known to have circulated in early Heian Japan (the original is quoted in much greater detail by Zenju 善珠 in the *Inmyō ron-shō myōtō shō* [KR6o0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0009)). The Xuzangjing recension's title 因明入正理門論述記 is misleading: it should not be read as if commenting on the *Rù lùn* [KR6o0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0003); the body of the text is unambiguously a commentary on the *Mūla* / Nyāyamukha [KR6o0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0001). The composition window — between Xuánzàng's translation of the *Mūla* (650) and Shéntài's death — is the same as for [KR6o0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0007).
